Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet, a NEW original forest duende NPC, not the protagonist. Character: Brizno, a VERY stout elderly male with a pear-shaped enormous belly, tiny tucked legs, prominent rosy hooked nose, drooping long WHITE WALRUS MOUSTACHE but NO beard, sparse wispy hair at his ears, thick white eyebrow tufts, small half-moon spectacles, amused tired eyes. A SHORT LILAC POINTED CAP with a sharply curled tip and one stitched patch, cream/mustard striped linen shirt pulled over his round belly, dark-plum suspenders, russet short trousers, broad dark leather slippers. Pointed ears. This character is visibly distinct from a conventional bearded green-hat gnome: funny eccentric uncle, warm natural light skin. Full body.
Create EXACTLY 32 complete sprites in an 8-column by 4-row regular contact sheet, WIDE 2:1 aspect, each cell equal sized, absolutely even spacing, generous empty padding around every hat, hands and feet. NO printed grid or labels. Camera consistent overhead three-quarter top-down RPG, refined hand-crafted pixel-art, clean coherent edges, expressive small facial features, warm woodland storybook material detail, readable at 40px tall, no blur, no chunky low-res enlargement. Columns left to right facing DOWN, DOWN-RIGHT, RIGHT, UP-RIGHT, UP, UP-LEFT, LEFT, DOWN-LEFT; the character rotates correctly, back in column 5. All four rows show him SITTING on an INVISIBLE low bench with thighs forward, bent knees and feet planted in precisely the same position per column. No chair or bench drawn; it will be a separate prop. Row1 plaintive hungry hands on belly; row2 speaking one hand very slightly raised; row3 happy relaxed hands on belly; row4 subtle blink. Lower-body registration exactly identical all rows. Soft consistent upper-left light, no ground shadow, no objects. Genuine transparent alpha background, not white and not checkerboard. Every individual cell contains the complete figure with air around silhouette; do not crop the hat or shoes. One consistent identity in all 32 sprites. No text, no watermark, no props.
walk: Use case: stylized-concept; production animation sprite sheet. Preserve exactly the original duende in the reference: Brizno, an elderly very FAT pear-bellied woodland elf, tiny legs, broad rosy hooked nose, enormous drooping white walrus moustache (not a long beard), white bushy eyebrows and half-moon spectacles, small curled LILAC pointed cap, cream-and-mustard striped shirt, dark plum suspenders, russet short trousers, soft brown slippers. Same natural peach skin, identity and colours. CHANGE from sitting to STANDING/WALKING; no bench or furniture. Exactly 8 columns by 4 rows, 32 full figures, 2:1 landscape. Columns facing down, down-right, right, up-right, up, up-left, left, down-left. Row 1 idle standing, row 2 walking left foot forward, row 3 passing step, row 4 right foot forward. Consistent three-quarter top-down view, sharp small game-art detail, actual different legs in walk poses. Tiny legs bear his large belly; restrained arm swing. FULL silhouette with at least 20 source pixels empty space ABOVE every cap and BELOW every slipper, all sprites centered within equal cells. Never cut off hat or boots. Genuine transparent alpha background. No checkerboard, no labels, no letters, no floor, no shadows. No red or coloured matte fringe.
